name: Banana Bread
parsedIngredients: 1 ½ cups all-purpose flour, 1 cup sugar, 1 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon baking soda, 2 raw eggs, 1 cup mashed banana, ½ cup cooking oil, 1 teaspoon vanilla essence, ½ cup chocolate chips (optional) ½ cup chopped walnuts (optional)
instructions:
1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).
2. In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, salt, and baking soda until well combined.
3. To the same bowl, add the eggs, mashed banana, cooking oil, and vanilla essence. Mix thoroughly with a spatula until you achieve a thick, smooth batter.
4. If using the optional chocolate chips/chopped walnuts, gently fold them in.
5. Grease a loaf pan evenly with cooking spray or oil. Pour the batter into the pan, spreading it evenly.
6. Place the pan in the preheated oven and bake for about 1 hour, or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
7. Remove the pan from the oven and let the banana bread cool inside it for 10–15 minutes. Then, transfer it to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.
8. Serve at room temperature or chilled (if preferred).
9. Store leftovers in an airtight container at room temperature for 2–3 days or in the fridge for up to 5 days.
